entries.12429b3ea36690f9: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] describes the group (the company, 16 consolidated subsidiaries and 2 non-consolidated subsidiaries) as a comprehensive lock manufacturer group that provides keys and locks for automobiles, housing, industrial equipment, labor-saving equipment and other fields. The business consists of two businesses: the automotive parts business and the security equipment business, and the automotive parts business accounted for 79.0% of consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026. entries.1edb8d934a4a0482: A reportable segment that makes and sells automotive key sets, door handles and other products in the Czech Republic, Slovakia and France, and the category with the largest revenue from external customers among the six reportable segments. It is handled by Alpha Vehicle Security Solutions Czech s. r. o. in the Czech Republic, Alpha Europe Holdings S.A.S. (which manages and oversees the entire European regional business) and Alpha France S.A.S. in France, and Alpha Slovakia s.r.o. in Slovakia. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥18,379 million (108.7% of the previous year's level), and segment profit was ¥421 million, an increase of ¥248 million from the previous year. The securities report cites an increase in order volume and progress in rationalization activities as the reasons. Alpha Vehicle Security Solutions Czech s. r. o. is a consolidated subsidiary whose revenue (excluding internal revenue between consolidated companies) exceeds 10% of consolidated revenue.

entries.449d95fd10292c6b: A reportable segment that makes and sells automotive key sets, door handles and similar products in Japan. The Company and the consolidated subsidiary Kyushu Alpha Co., Ltd. (voting rights ownership 100.0%) in Yukuhashi, Fukuoka Prefecture, are in charge. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥8,152 million (100.1% of the previous year's period), and segment profit was ¥752 million, ¥441 million more than in the previous year's period. The securities report states that although customers' production volumes decreased both domestically and for export, revenue increased owing to an increase in value-added products and other factors. It explains that profit increased owing to the effects of rationalization improvements and restraint of fixed costs, although recovery of some costs was delayed.
entries.4b36285d9c496a6b: A reportable segment that makes and sells entrance door locks, locks for industrial equipment, various lockers and similar products in Japan. The Company sells residential locks and other products, and the consolidated subsidiary Alpha Locker System Co., Ltd. (voting rights ownership 100.0%) manufactures, sells, rents and maintains coin lockers and similar products. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥12,347 million (90.5% of the previous year's period), and segment profit was ¥1,340 million, ¥276 million less than in the previous year's period. The securities report states that although demand for smart locks is spreading, a project for a major rental housing business operator that had continued since fiscal 2022 was completed, and sales of housing-related products fell below the previous year's period. In the locker system business, large orders were won on demand to replace lockers, such as renewals of golf course locker rooms, and the operation business was also favorable owing to an increase in foreign visitors to Japan, but sales fell below the previous year's period because of a reaction to the several special demand cases in the previous year's period.

entries.ac691a107930d971: A reportable segment that makes and sells automotive key sets, door handles and similar products in Thailand, China, India and Indonesia. ALPHA INDUSTRY (Thailand) CO.,LTD. in Thailand, ALPHA (GUANGZHOU) AUTOMOTIVE PARTS CO.,LTD. in China (voting rights ownership 90.0%) and ALPHA ADVANCED AUTOMOTIVE PARTS CO.,LTD. (same, 52.9%, all indirectly owned), and Alpha Security Instruments (India) Private Limited in India are in charge. PT. ALPHA AUTOMOTIVE INDONESIA in Indonesia was dissolved in December 2023 and is in liquidation proceedings. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥15,274 million (105.4% of the previous year's period), and the segment loss was ¥922 million (previous year's period: segment loss of ¥923 million). The securities report states that although sales slowed in Thailand, revenue increased because sales of vehicles ordered by local-brand makers in China were strong. It explains that in China fixed costs were reduced through consolidation of sites and reorganization of the organizational structure, but the segment recorded a loss because improvement in the profitability of new products was delayed, among other factors.

The annual securities report's 'business and other risks' section states that results of operations may be affected by production trends of automobile manufacturers, including major sales customers, the installation rate of the group's products, and product delivery prices. entries.f964f8c94380f392: A reportable segment that makes and sells entrance door locks, locks for industrial equipment, various lockers and similar products in Thailand and China. The list of consolidated subsidiaries states that ALPHA HOUSING HARDWARE (THAILAND) CO.,LTD. in Thailand (voting rights ownership 100.0%, of which 6.6% is indirectly owned) manufactures and sells residential locks. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥2,921 million (114.1% of the previous year's period), and segment profit was ¥705 million, ¥197 million less than in the previous year's period. The management's analysis states that sales including internal sales between segments were ¥8,733 million, ¥987 million less than in the previous year's period, and gives a decrease in production of products for Japan (electric locks) as the reason. Sales to external customers increased, and this category is affected by transactions with other segments.

ALPHA TECHNOLOGY CORPORATION in the United States (parts sales) and ALPHA INDUSTRY QUERETARO, S.A. DE C.V., Alpha Industry Jalisco, S.A. DE C.V. and ALPHA INDUSTRY PUEBLA, S.A. DE C.V. in Mexico (manufacturing and sales) are in charge.
